<translate>
The '''Time Patroller''' stands in the central plaza of every demon village in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. He sells the maps to the Demon Realm [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|world boss]] lairs: the three Tamagamis, one per Demon World floor, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]].
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>

|-

|}

<translate>
A map stays '''out of stock''' until its boss's lair has been located. The lairs are picked while players are in the Demon Realm, so explore it first and re-open the trade window later. His trades restock once per in-game day.
</translate>

{{Note|type=warning|title=<translate>Alignment</translate>|<translate>Killing the Time Patroller or a Demon Realm Villager lowers your alignment.</translate>}}
